conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and building a cash buffer, accepting lower growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to 3% and 2% respectively, reducing leverage.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% monthly returns by reducing concentration and leverage while adding a quality growth name. It maintains a moderate risk profile with a small cash buffer.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and free up capital.
